svg.title: Särkisuo: daily GPP, Reco and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1), air temperature, soil water content and precipitation from 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31, with the recorded management events.
svg.desc: Four panels on one date axis (local time, UTC+2) from 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31. 730 days with gap-filled NEE; 50 days with a measured fraction of NEE below 10 % are drawn lighter. Daily GPP from −2.0 to 15.4, Reco from 0.0 to 8.4 and NEE from −9.1 to 8.6 g C m-2 d-1 (NEE < 0 = uptake). 11 recorded events in the period (4 harvest, 4 fertilisation, 1 spraying, 2 other), drawn as vertical lines with a type label above panel (a). 1 events lie outside the flux period and are not drawn: sowing 2021-06-09. Largest change of daily GPP near each event: harvest 2022-06-30: GPP drop on 2022-06-30 (0 d, clear); harvest 2022-08-15: GPP drop on 2022-08-15 (0 d, clear); harvest 2023-06-29: too few days for the search; harvest 2023-08-15: GPP drop on 2023-08-15 (0 d, clear). Grey bands: thermal growing season, 2022: 2022-05-09 to 2022-11-13 (188 d); 2023: 2023-05-07 to 2023-10-15 (161 d).
